object.title: Longitudinal Audit of Research Software Identity Propagation Across Open Scholarly Infrastructures

provenance.acquisition_timestamp_precision: UTC day label only; not an exact HTTP response timestamp

interpretation.bounded_claim: DataCite records 30 unique regular dataset investigations for the OSF preregistration DOI in the October 2026 OSF-submitted usage report; the Commons page supplied by the user displays 30 Views.
interpretation.unique_semantics: DataCite Event Data defines unique usage as counting access once per content item within a unique user session.
interpretation.regular_semantics: The regular category is distinct from the machine access category.
interpretation.independent_of_this_patrol_agent: The usage event is attributed to the OSF DataCite client da_COS.OSF and concerns the October reporting period, not this patrol's retrieval requests.
